Frequently asked questions

Answers to the questions I am asked most often. One missing? Write to me.

The build

I have no text and no photos. Is that a problem?

No. We write the text together from what you tell me, and I choose royalty-free photos that suit your business. You can replace them with your own whenever you like.

Which website to choose?

A single page if you are starting out or a few lines are enough to introduce you: it is your business card on the internet. Several pages if you have several services or want to rank well on Google: each page covers one topic, and Google can show every one of them. The price stays the same up to 10 pages, so choose according to what you have to say. Add the online shop if you want to sell your products online. Not sure? Write to us and we will advise you.

Is the build price really fixed?

Yes: €500 for your website, one page or several, up to 10 pages. An online shop adds €200. Need more room? Each page beyond 10 costs €10, paid once. Everything is written in the summary before we start.

How is this different from a website made by a developer?

For a showcase website or a small shop, you get a comparable result: modern, fast, polished. I design and build your website myself, and my little band of automations takes on whatever repeats. That makes me faster, and cheaper. For a made-to-measure application or a very big catalogue, nothing replaces a developer’s expertise, and I will say so.

How do I pay for the build?

You pay 25% when you order. When you receive the website, you pay the rest in one go, or in 6 or 12 interest-free instalments. Your subscription starts that day, not before.

Ordering

What happens when I order?

You put your website together, then click Order. You read the summary, enter your details and pay online. A confirmation email arrives straight away, with an order reference. I then write to you to get started.

What do I pay today?

Only 25% of the website, plus any one-off options. The subscription only starts when the website is delivered, with the rest paid in one go or in 6 or 12 interest-free instalments. The exact amount shows on the button before you confirm.

Can I pay for the website in instalments?

Yes. After the 25% deposit, the rest is paid at delivery, in 6 or 12 interest-free instalments. For a €500 website: €125 when you order, then €62.50 a month for 6 months, or €31.25 for 12 months. The subscription is then paid monthly. Nothing more once it is paid off.

Am I tied in?

No. The subscription stops when you decide, at the end of the paid period. The only exception: if you pay the rest of the website in 6 or 12 instalments, you commit for the payment period. If you leave early, what remains of the website price is due in one go.

Can I add or remove an extra later?

Yes, whenever you like, from your client area. The new price starts from the next period. Build options, on the other hand, are paid once: to add one afterwards, write to me.

How are invoices issued?

For each payment, Stripe issues the invoice and emails it to you. You can also find it in your client area. VAT is not shown: the business is VAT-exempt (article 293 B of the French General Tax Code).

What happens if I stop?

You let me know, and the subscription ends at the end of the current period. You leave with your domain name and a full copy of your website. Hosting with me stays active for 30 days, giving you time to move.

What if I change my mind?

You have 14 days, by simple email. Since you ask me to start straight away, you only pay for the work already done, pro rata. The domain name already registered stays at your cost: it is in your name, for one year.

Prices and the subscription

How much does it cost, all in?

€500 once for the website, then €10 a month for the subscription. The website price does not change, from one page to 10 pages. So the first year comes to €620, or €600 if you pay the subscription yearly.

What does the subscription include?

Everything that keeps your website running: the domain name, held in your name and renewed yearly, along with hosting, updates, backups and monitoring. You also get support, with an answer within 72 hours, and the basics of SEO. The guardian, a little monster from my band, watches over your website. You also enjoy the band’s small edits and tools, included as long as use stays normal. Plus one change by Alex every quarter. Signed up before 16 November 2026? You keep one change by Alex every month.

Is the subscription required?

Yes, as long as your website is online with me: it pays for the domain name, the hosting and the upkeep. But there is no commitment. You stop it whenever you like, and you keep your domain name and a copy of your website.

Who are the little monsters?

They are my automations. I programmed them one by one, then drew them as little monsters. Each one handles a repetitive but useful task, and works on its own. The basic subscription includes three: the assistant, the guardian and the handyman. The guardian looks after updates, backups, security and monitoring, and the handyman takes care of your small changes. In your client area, the writer and the messenger give you a hand every day. Each monthly option adds another one: the Google star with Google follow-up, the observer with Detailed figures, the postman with Business email address, the storekeeper with Stock management and the host with Customer accounts. I always check what they do.

What if I need more changes?

Small edits go through the band, and you can get more if you go beyond normal use. Would you like Alex to come back before the next quarter? From your client area, order an extra change by Alex for €5. It is added to your following invoice.

Is a failed edit counted?

No. It does not count if publishing fails, if you turn down the preview or if the request is passed to Alex. The same goes when you cancel a request within 24 hours of sending it, up to three times a month.

Who makes my changes?

It is your choice, for every request. For a small edit, the handyman, one of the little monsters in the band, prepares the change in a few minutes and shows you a preview: nothing moves on your website without your approval. The bigger ones I do by hand: one change per quarter is included, carried out within 72 hours and checked by me personally. I also keep an eye on what the band does.

Which extras can I add to the subscription?

You pay for them monthly, and you can add or drop them at any time from your client area: Google follow-up for €10, Detailed figures for €5 and Business email address for €3. Online shops can also have Stock management and Customer accounts, at €5 each. Each one adds a little monster to your band. None of them is compulsory.

What about on-demand extras?

They are paid once, only when you need them: an extra change by Alex at €5, your request within 24 hours at €5, an article written and published at €15, one more page at €10, or a 30-minute call with Alex at €15. You order them yourself from your client area, and the amount is added to your next invoice. No order, nothing to pay.

And for an online shop?

It is €200 more for the build, so €700 once. The subscription stays at €10 a month. The shop includes card payment, order tracking and up to 20 products that I add for you.

Monthly or yearly?

As you like. Monthly, the subscription costs €10. Yearly, it costs €100: you pay for ten months at once and 2 are free. You can switch from one to the other at renewal.

What counts as a change?

A precise change to an existing page: opening hours, a price, a photo, a text, a product. One request, one change. Alex’s quarterly change does not carry over if you do not use it. A new page costs €10, ordered from your client area. A new feature needs a small quote.

Why is it 4 to 5 times cheaper than a website made by hand?

Because I spent a lot of time programming my little band, automations that take care of everything that repeats. I also have direct access to French hosting providers. No magic involved, just optimisation. When an agency or a freelancer makes a showcase website by hand, it generally costs between €1,500 and €3,000. With me, it is €500. You are not paying for weeks of work, yet I still design, review and test your website myself.

Are there any hidden costs?

No. The summary lists it all: the website build, the subscription, plus the options and extras you picked. On-demand extras are only charged if you order them. Nothing else.

Your client area

How do I request a change?

From your client area: you write down what you would like to change, with a photo if needed. Then you choose: a small edit by the band, or a change I make by hand. A question along the way? The chat bubble at the bottom of the screen is there for that.

How long does it take?

A small edit takes a few minutes: once you approve the preview, it is live. For work by hand, I get back to you within 72 hours on working days, and a small change is generally finished in that time. I tell you as soon as it is done. Short on time? With the “Your request within 24 hours” extra, at €5, your request is handled first.

How is my account created?

Automatically, as soon as your order is confirmed. You can also create it beforehand, without ordering anything, on the My account page. Either way, you receive an email with a link to choose your password. If an account already existed with your address, the order is simply linked to it.

Can my account be deleted?

Only if it is no longer used: no login for 12 months and no active subscription. I warn you by email 30 days before, and simply logging in cancels it all. As long as your subscription is running, your account stays.

Is the client area paid?

No, it comes with the subscription: change requests, dashboard, referrals and invoices. The writer’s and the messenger’s tools are included too, for normal use. That is also where you order on-demand extras.

What happens if I use the tools a lot?

For normal use, nothing at all: the tools and small edits are included. If you use them a lot more, you can get extra from your client area, starting at €1, added to your next invoice. Whatever you top up stays available until you have used it.

SEO

How long until I am on Google?

Your website is submitted to Google as soon as it goes live. People find it quickly by your name. For more competitive searches, allow a few weeks to a few months.

Is SEO included in the subscription?

The basics, yes: Google can read and understand your website. To help it climb month after month, there is the Google follow-up extra, at €10 a month: the Google star then joins your band. You can take it whenever you want, and stop it the same way.

Can you guarantee me first place?

No, and nobody honestly can. I give you every chance. With the Google follow-up extra, I show you every month where you stand.

What is optimised content?

An article or page that answers a genuine question your customers ask, with clear headings and links to your services. The band prepares a first version, and I proofread it before it goes online. To order just one, choose the “An article written and published” extra, at €15.

I already have a website. Can you improve it?

Yes. I look at your website and tell you what is holding back your visibility. Write to me for a quote.

My method

Will my customers see that automations were used?

No, nothing on your website says so. They see a clean, fast website. For my part, I prefer to tell you how I work: you know what you are buying.

Can the little monsters make mistakes?

Yes, like any automatic tool. That is why I check their work, and why nothing is published without your approval. They are quick, but I am the one who signs off.

Do the little monsters build my website?

No. I design and build your website myself, page by page. The band takes care of the repetitive work around it: updates, backups, monitoring, small edits. Making the choices, proofreading and checking: that is my job.

The comparison

Why are you cheaper than an agency?

Because I work differently. My little band of automations handles the repetitive tasks, and I deal directly with French hosting providers, with no middleman. I have no office rent to pay and no team to keep running. I keep my projects simple, the kind I know how to do well. If your project is big, an agency is still the right choice.

How is it different from a do-it-yourself platform?

Who does the work. On a platform, you build the website, update it and write for Google, often in the evening. With me, you describe what you want and I do it. You have no tool to learn.

And compared with a freelancer?

A freelancer creates your website, and after that each change gets negotiated whenever they have time. My subscription picks things up from there: hosting, backups, updates, the band and its tools, one change by Alex per quarter, all included. You know the price in advance.

If I leave, can I take my website with me?

Yes. The domain name is yours and can be transferred wherever you like. I also give you the website files, so you can host it elsewhere. Nothing ties you down.

Loyalty

How does my referred friend benefit from the referral?

They use your referral link, or enter your code in their order. When their website is online, you each get 1 month of subscription free.

Where can I find my link and my code?

In your client area, under the Referral tab. The link can be shared by message or on social media. The code is typed into the order form. Both give the same benefit.

When is the free month applied?

As soon as your referred friend’s website is online. It is deducted from your next invoice, and from theirs. It cannot be exchanged for money.

Can the benefits be combined?

Yes: you can refer several people. Each referred friend who goes online gives you one more month.

Shall we create your website?

Build your website in two minutes. You see the price straight away, and you order when you are ready.
